note: Based on recorded events; coverage is more limited before the year 2000. Longer historical trends may partly reflect reporting improvements.
title: Decadal average: Annual rate of people left homeless by landslides
subtitle: Rates are measured per 100,000 people. Decadal figures are measured as the annual average over the subsequent ten-year period. Landslides are sudden movements of material down a slope, including wet mass movements (such as mudflows triggered by heavy rain or melting snow) and dry mass movements (such as rockfalls).
